{{Quote|Welcome to the 7-Gee Lounge, sir. I'm your host, EV-7G7. Would you like a drink?|[[EV-7G7]] welcoming [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] to the 7-Gee Lounge|<ref name="Star Wars Episode I: The Phantom Menace (video game)" />}}
The '''7-Gee Lounge''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] inside the [[Mos Espa Grand Arena/Legends|Mos Espa Grand Arena]] complex on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].

==Description==
7-Gee Lounge was part of the [[Mos Espa Grand Arena/Legends|Mos Espa Grand Arena]] complex, on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. It had a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] as a [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]], [[EV-7G7]], who served [[Juri juice/Legends|juri juice]] and [[Bantha blaster/Legends|bantha blasters]], among other drinks. EV-7G7 moved via a trench in the balcony, in order to provide a quicker service to its costumers. The cantina had a small stage which was set up for performers. In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], the entertainers included two [[Musician/Legends|musicians]]: a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] and an [[Ortolan/Legends|Ortolan]] who played a [[Nalargon/Legends|nalargon]].<ref name="Star Wars Episode I: The Phantom Menace (video game)" />

==History==
[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] visited the cantina while searching for the junkdealer [[Watto/Legends|Watto]], in order to place a bet on [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] for the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Podrace]]. Having found only [[Watto's flunky]] with his friend [[Kreg]], Jinn asked EV-7G7 for two juri juices to offer both individuals in order for Watto's flunky to help him find Watto. The deed eventually proved successful as the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] ended up completing his objective.<ref name="Star Wars Episode I: The Phantom Menace (video game)" />

The 7-Gee Lounge was also a favorite drinking spot of the [[Podracer/Legends|podracer]] [[Teemto Pagalies/Legends|Teemto Pagalies]].<ref name="Star Wars Episode I: The Phantom Menace (video game)" />

==Behind the scenes==
The 7-Gee Lounge appears in the [[1999]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (video game)|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' video game]] during the [[Mos Espa Grand Arena/Legends|Mos Espa Arena]] level. However, the events of this level of the game somewhat contradict the ones depicted in [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|the movie]], as the bet against [[Sebulba/Legends|Sebulba]] happened inside the podrace hangar.<ref name="Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace">{{Film|I}}</ref>

In the [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|official strategy guide]], it is referred to as "7-G Lounge".<ref name="Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace: Prima's Official Strategy Guide">[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref>

Part of the music that is played in the 7-Gee Lounge is also heard in the [[Entertainment Module 081 Cantina|Telos IV cantina]] in ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''.<ref name="Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref>
